statusDefinitions.verified-present: At least one reputable source supports a recorded presence in the county.
statusDefinitions.verified-absent: An authoritative source explicitly supports absence for the county and species.
statusDefinitions.not-detected: A documented survey or monitoring effort searched and did not detect the species. This is not absence.
statusDefinitions.researched-unresolved: At least one source family was screened, but no defensible present, absent, or not-detected determination was established.
statusDefinitions.not-researched: No recorded source-family screen or determination exists for this county-species pair.
